# Exams

## General exam info

- The exams are designed to occupy the entire class period.
- You should only have a writing tool, no notes, calculators, etc are allowed.
  I will bring some scratch paper.
  If you use it, mark your name on each page and staple it to your exam.

## Exam 1

The first exam takes place in class on March 13.

- The exam will cover through homework/quiz 5.
  I will only ask questions that are similar to what is on the homework and quizzes. Those are your study materials.
- If you would like additional practice problems, consider these (you can talk about them with me in office hours, but I won't be providing solutions).
- The take-home portion of the exam is due in class on March 20.
